issue.title: Split the three Contribute pages over the 8,000-word warning cap
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1le.20.1.21 (finish, epic sase-1le.20.1) in note #3.

`tools/check_docs` (via `just docs-lint`) warns that three contributor pages exceed the
8,000-word Contribute cap: `docs/contribute/development.md` (12,350 words),
`docs/contribute/rust-backend.md` (11,268), and `docs/contribute/perf-runbook.md`
(10,950). The warning text says "This page may not grow. Split it". Split each page into
goal-sized contribute pages under the cap. Use `tools/docs_split` with a committed
mapping under `docs/_meta/splits/` so old anchors keep resolving. Keep
`docs/rust_backend.md`'s stub working (the core memory note
`rust_core_backend_boundary.md` cites it), and update the `tui_perf.md` memory pointers
to `docs/contribute/perf-runbook.md` if the runbook's sections move.

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
Epic sase-1le.20.1's plan moved these pages whole on purpose ("Contribute budgets are
warning-only, so the pages move whole"); splitting them is new editorial work outside
that move-only scope.

issue.creation_reason: Land triage of epic sase-1le.20.1: its finish phase reported development, rust-backend, and perf-runbook over the Contribute cap, and the epic moved them whole by design.
